race.comment: TARZING (10) progressive gelding who was just over a month between runs with an eye-catching sixth over this track and trip from an awkward gate. J Mac sticks and he gets a much better set-up for this with a fast tempo assured. Set to bounce back. STEEL STRIKE (9) bounced off his solid first-up third, with a game on-pace victory over most of these at this track and trip. Can handle the weight increase and figure prominently from the low draw. MR VERSE (4) talented gelding who savaged the line first-up from the wide gate with an unlucky fourth over 1200m at Flemington. Proven second-up and is expected to take a hand in the finish. SILVANITO (8) tough gelding adept in all conditions. Got the job done here two-back, then finished a narrow third with the weight increase at this track on August 1. Consistent gelding with solid claims in this vein of form. BARBARIC LAD (11) deep into the campaign and worth another chance from the inside gate.
